comment: Files that `mira deploy` ships, per machine. A plain string is copied to the same relative path; {src, dst} maps a repo path under wall/ to a path inside the install dir. Directories are shipped recursively without __pycache__. A "command" entry names the stable `mira` link under the install user's HOME: on the Pi it follows the current release, on the mini it points at the flat install. Every file the CLI reads at run time must be listed.
